title: Backend bug fix: an extra empty page at exact multiples
prompt: Customers report that the orders list shows an extra empty page. With 20 orders and pageSize=10, GET /api/orders says totalPages is 3. Fix the bug without changing the API response shape, and add a regression test.

scope.note: The fix belongs in the paging calculation; the response contract and project files stay unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: totalPages is the ceiling of totalCount / pageSize: 20 orders at 10 per page give 2; no orders give 0.
The response shape { items, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages } and the paging of items are unchanged; a page past the end is an empty 200.
Invalid paging still returns 400 problem details.
A regression test in the repository's test project fails on the original code and passes on the fix.
acceptanceCriteria.oracle: regression-test-detects: the agent's tests run against the original src/ must fail

negativeChecks: Invalid paging (pageSize 0 or 101, page 0) keeps returning 400 with application/problem+json.
A page past the end returns 200 with no items rather than an error.

negatives.detects: a correct fix with no regression test
a fix that renames totalPages in the public contract
a fix that only special-cases the reported numbers

reset: Give the agent a fresh copy of repo/ only (never grader/, reference/ or negatives/), initialised as a git repository with one commit. Reset by discarding the copy.
